question: In which of the following sites of Indus Valley Civilisation was ‘The Great Bath’ found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohenjo-Daro.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Great Bath **was found in the **1920s** during **excavations at Mohenjo-Daro.**
 
• The Bath is **83 square meters** in size and was built with **beautiful masonr**y.
 
• The Big Bath is an ancient building in** Mohenjo-Daro **that dates to the **third millennium BCE.**
 
• It is said to have been used for** ceremonial bathing**.
 
• Mohenjo-Daro, popularly known as **"Mound of the Dead,**" was one of the greatest cities of the **ancient Indus Valley Civilization.**
 
• The majority of homes had **small bathrooms and mud-plastered walls**, and the streets had plenty of **drains and sanitary facilities,** indicating that the city was well-planned.
 
• **It was believed that Mohenjo-Daro was divided** into two sections:
 
 
• **Citadel, **which served as the site's ceremonial administrative centre, and 
 
• **Lower Town**, had courtyard houses.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalibangan**:

 
 
• A significant provincial capital of the **Indus Valley Civilization **was Kalibangan.
 
• During excavations, an **Italian Indologist **found the **Kalibangan site.**
 
 
 
• **Dholavira:**
 
 
• **Gujarat's Bhachau Taluka of Kutch Distric**t is home to the archaeological site known as Dholavira.
 
• The city's most notable characteristic is that all of its structures are** made of stone**.
 
 
 
• **Lothal:**
 
 
• One of the most **southern Indus Valley civilization** sites was **Lothal**.
 
• It is located in the **Bhal region of the Indian state of Gujarat.**
 
• The discovery of numerous** Indus Valley Civilization** ruins in Lothal has made the city famous.
 
• Between **1955 and 1962, **Lothal underwent excavation.
